list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS __text, country_code AS __value FROM europe_jobs ORDER BY country_code)
list.definition: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS __text, country_code AS __value FROM europe_jobs ORDER BY country_code)

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Confirmed FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (     lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%junior%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%lead%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%principal%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%staff%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%manager%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%director%'     AND (lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%senior%' OR e.scope_eligibility = 'eligible') ) AND scope_eligibility = 'eligible'

targets.queryText: SELECT country_code AS Country, SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'eligible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Confirmed, SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Needs review' FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (     lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%junior%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%lead%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%principal%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%staff%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%manager%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%director%'     AND (lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%senior%' OR e.scope_eligibility = 'eligible') ) GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY Confirmed DESC, 'Needs review' DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT country_code AS Country, SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'eligible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Confirmed, SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Needs review' FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (     lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%junior%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%lead%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%principal%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%staff%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%manager%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%director%'     AND (lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%senior%' OR e.scope_eligibility = 'eligible') ) GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY Confirmed DESC, 'Needs review' DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (     lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%junior%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%lead%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%principal%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%staff%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%manager%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%director%'     AND (lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%senior%' OR e.scope_eligibility = 'eligible') ) AND (${eligibility:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.scope_eligibility = ${eligibility:sqlstring}) AND jt.requirement_type = 'required' GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (     lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%junior%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%lead%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%principal%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%staff%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%manager%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%director%'     AND (lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%senior%' OR e.scope_eligibility = 'eligible') ) AND (${eligibility:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.scope_eligibility = ${eligibility:sqlstring}) AND jt.requirement_type = 'required' GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 20

targets.queryText: SELECT e.title AS Title, e.company AS Company, e.country_code AS Country, e.location AS Location, CASE WHEN e.is_remote = 1 THEN 'Remote' ELSE 'On-site' END AS Mode, COALESCE(CAST(e.required_experience_years AS TEXT), 'Unknown') AS 'Years required', e.scope_eligibility AS Eligibility, e.published_at AS Published, e.canonical_url AS URL FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (     lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%junior%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%lead%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%principal%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%staff%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%manager%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%director%'     AND (lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%senior%' OR e.scope_eligibility = 'eligible') ) AND (${eligibility:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.scope_eligibility = ${eligibility:sqlstring}) AND (${remote:sqlstring} = '__all' OR CAST(e.is_remote AS TEXT) = ${remote:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE e.scope_eligibility WHEN 'eligible' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, e.is_remote DESC, e.published_at DESC LIMIT 250
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT e.title AS Title, e.company AS Company, e.country_code AS Country, e.location AS Location, CASE WHEN e.is_remote = 1 THEN 'Remote' ELSE 'On-site' END AS Mode, COALESCE(CAST(e.required_experience_years AS TEXT), 'Unknown') AS 'Years required', e.scope_eligibility AS Eligibility, e.published_at AS Published, e.canonical_url AS URL FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (     lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%junior%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%lead%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%principal%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%staff%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%manager%'     AND lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%director%'     AND (lower(e.title) NOT LIKE '%senior%' OR e.scope_eligibility = 'eligible') ) AND (${eligibility:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.scope_eligibility = ${eligibility:sqlstring}) AND (${remote:sqlstring} = '__all' OR CAST(e.is_remote AS TEXT) = ${remote:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE e.scope_eligibility WHEN 'eligible' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, e.is_remote DESC, e.published_at DESC LIMIT 250
